died.name: Philip Sidney
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Zutphen, passing a cup of water to another wounded soldier
died.last_words: Take it; thy need is greater than mine.

died.name: Margaret Mary Alacoque
died.desc: French Roman Catholic nun, promoter of devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
died.last_words: I need nothing but God, and to lose myself in the heart of Jesus.

died.name: Victims of the London Beer Flood
died.cause: At Meux & Co's Horse Shoe Brewery, a 22-foot-tall (6.7 m) wooden vat of fermenting porter burst, causing chain reactions and destroying several large beer barrels. The beer subsequently flooded the nearby slum and killed eight people. Several people also reportedly died from alcohol poisoning as a result of drinking the flooded liquor.

died.name: Frédéric Chopin
died.cause: asked by his physician if he was suffering

died.name: Julia Ward Howe
died.last_words: God will help me. I am so tired.

born.name: Pope John Paul I
born.desc: Italian Roman Catholic prelate and Pope
born.cause: who had just elected as Pope following the papal conclave on the death of his predecessor, Pope Paul VI, who died in 6 August
born.last_words: Tomorrow, we will see each other, if the Lord still wishes it, and we will celebrate Mass together.
